model_identity: 國立高雄大學人文社會科學院 A/B 完整相連主樓
scope: Tender-design and early official-photo exterior miniature; separate C building, full site, hidden basement and room interiors excluded. Not a 2026 survey or exact as-built reconstruction.

personally_viewed_final_previews.assessment: Two unequal U courtyards and corner glazing remain distinct. High A and low B front porticos each have one connected wide canopy with open space below. No spurious lower A full-span slab.

The A rear lecture projection now rises outward under a sloping roof. The former false room/steps at the other rear corner are replaced by the visible descending parking-ramp mouth. Exterior screens remain visible; rear openings are design-based approximations.
Three-floor A and two-floor B height distinction, inward roof-edge fall and open high/low frame silhouettes read clearly. End-wall/window and column sections are miniaturized rather than surveyed.

Two U openings rotate 90 degrees and connect only at their intended corner. Six recessed roof platforms, continuous mitred inward slopes and two small water-service parts are distinguishable. C is absent; the display base is not landscape.
Opposite oblique confirms the courtyard negative spaces, corner link, inner galleries and outer screens; lower B is not a duplicated equal-height A. Entire model is in frame.

source_binding.viewing_scope: Ten final readable CAD panels and seven official images were personally viewed during source review; plans 1F/2F, facades 1/2/4, home0/home1 were reopened for this finished-model comparison. All current source-file bytes match their viewing manifest.
source_binding.source_independence: Ten CAD panels derive from one DWG, not ten independent designs. Opening ceremony and award poster support identity/date only; poster bottom administration-building photo is excluded from geometry.
source_binding.dates: Official chronology: groundbreaking 2010-03-29; inauguration 2012-06-21. pic7 EXIF 2012-02-03 and pic8/9 2012-03-28 without timezone. home images lack reliable original capture dates. ZIP modification date is not completion.

first_pass_corrections_resolved.initial_reading_correction: Initial visual reading as stairs was explicitly withdrawn after original DWG text identified 地下停車場車道 at (-13048.1600,30240.4925).
first_pass_corrections_resolved.resolution: False classroom box and nested upward steps removed. Finished mesh contains a short descending ramp mouth and side walls in the display base. Hidden ramp continuation/basement is omitted, not reconstructed.
Flat box replaced with source-supported outward-rising roof silhouette. Independent finished-STL downward-ray heights rise from 13.569 to 15.847 to 18.581 mm.

A full-span lower slab removed from its false lower position; wide canopy now joins the high frame. B canopy joins its lower frame. Independent mesh tests confirm air at former A low-slab elevation and below both canopies.

independently_verified.method: Direct binary STL and zipped 3MF XML, all ordered triangles and materials; finished-mesh ray/containment tests and camera projection. No builder geometry/probe function imported.
independently_verified.six_platform_floor_heights: A 28.25 mm / B 20.25 mm at independently chosen points, with real recesses rather than roof-glass patches.

builder_qa_read_not_rerun.isolated_rebuild: Builder reports four geometry/data outputs plus all five PNGs byte-identical. I checked every listed final-file digest; I did not independently execute that whole rebuild.
builder_qa_read_not_rerun.other_qa: Builder aggregate, strict 3MF, real Blend vertex/material editing and saved-scene front rerender reports reviewed for this STL. The local 170-layer erosion/feature checks are not physical print tests or a global minimum-wall certification.

remaining_approximation_limits: Formal tender-design DWG supplements unphotographed rear details; not all individual as-built openings are photographed.
Facade/window/railing and screen counts, column sections, service details and local dimensions are simplified photo/design proportions, not a survey. Opaque glass is a color proxy.
Room volumes are solid print proxies; courtyards and open colonnades remain genuine negative spaces.
Ramp mouth is a bounded visible exterior approximation within a display plinth; basement depth, internal circulation and full underground access are not claimed.
No additional outside stair towers were made from displaced drawing stair diagrams. Real source-supported low projections remain.
Gray/warm palette is not color-calibrated. Private original CAD and photographic files must not be bundled for public redistribution.
Long beams, gallery slabs, thin fins and roof edges still require slicer/support assessment. No physical print, support-free or guaranteed strength claim.
acceptance_boundary: Approval applies only to the exact bound V2 artifacts and stated exterior-approximation scope. Later core/PNG changes require rebinding and any material geometry change requires renewed review.
